summary: WeRide Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a monthly return (Exhibit 99.1) submitted to The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited regarding movements in authorized share capital and issued shares for July 2026. The report shows no changes in authorized or issued shares during the month, with balances unchanged at 4.5 billion Class A and 500 million Class B authorized shares, and issued shares comprising 932,053,942 Class A ordinary shares plus treasury shares. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or capital return is described. This is a routine periodic disclosure, equivalent to a standard share capital movement report, not a special situation.
